title: The Diamond Sutra: The Perfection of Wisdom
author: Red Pine (translator)
blurb: The translation we quote from most often on this site — clear English facing the classical Chinese, with accessible commentary.

title: Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind
author: Shunryu Suzuki
blurb: Not about the Diamond Sutra directly, but the single best companion for approaching it without a head full of assumptions.

title: The Diamond That Cuts Through Illusion
author: Thich Nhat Hanh
blurb: A warm, application-focused commentary — closest in spirit to the 'life-feedback' approach we take here.

title: The Way of Zen
author: Alan Watts
blurb: Essential background on how the sutra's ideas travelled into Zen practice — referenced often in our webinars.

title: A Comprehensive Commentary on the Diamond Sutra
author: Tripitaka Master Hsuan Hua
blurb: Line-by-line traditional commentary for students who want to go past the popular translations.
